rules.text: A ROBOT may not PIN an opponent's ROBOT for more than 3 seconds. A ROBOT is PINNING if it is preventing the movement of an opponent ROBOT by contact, either direct or transitive (such as against a FIELD element).
rules.violation: MINOR FOUL, and for every 3 seconds in which the situation is not corrected, a MAJOR FOUL is assessed.

rules.topic: damaging or tipping an opponent robot
rules.text: A ROBOT with BUMPERS completely outside of their ALLIANCE ZONE may not damage or functionally impair an opponent ROBOT by initiating contact, either directly or transitively via a SCORING ELEMENT CONTROLLED by the ROBOT: A. inside the vertical projection of an opponent’s ROBOT PERIMETER, or B. with the opponent’s BUMPER backing or mounting.
rules.violation: MAJOR FOUL and YELLOW CARD, or if opponent ROBOT is unable to drive, then MAJOR FOUL and RED CARD

rules.topic: contacting an opponent climbing or on the TOWER
rules.text: A ROBOT may not contact, directly or transitively through a SCORING ELEMENT, an opponent ROBOT in contact with an opponent TOWER during the last 30 seconds of the MATCH regardless of who initiates contact.
rules.violation: MAJOR FOUL and if the opponent ROBOT is off the ground the opponent ROBOT is awarded LEVEL 3 TOWER points.

rules.topic: blocking or trapping multiple opponents / shutting down major gameplay
rules.text: 2 or more ROBOTS that appear to a REFEREE to be working together may not isolate or close off any major element of MATCH play.
rules.violation: MAJOR FOUL, and for every 3 seconds in which the situation is not corrected, a MAJOR FOUL is assessed.
rules.quote: 2 or more ROBOTS that appear to a REFEREE to be working together may not isolate or close off any major element of MATCH play.

rules.topic: robots leaving the field or extending beyond a size limit
rules.text: A ROBOT may not extend beyond any of the horizontal or vertical expansion limits described in R105, R106, and R107.

rules.topic: human player / OUTPOST FUEL feeding rules
rules.text: FUEL may only be introduced to the FIELD by a HUMAN PLAYER or DRIVER in the following ways: A. through the CHUTE, B. through the bottom opening in the OUTPOST, or C. thrown over the top of the ALLIANCE WALL from the OUTPOST AREA.

rules.topic: intentionally forcing an opponent to break a rule
rules.text: A strategy not consistent with standard gameplay and clearly aimed at forcing the opponent ALLIANCE to violate a rule is not in the spirit of FIRST Robotics Competition and not allowed. Rule violations forced in this manner will not result in an assignment of a penalty to the targeted ALLIANCE.
rules.violation: MAJOR FOUL. YELLOW CARD if REPEATED.
